nodes.notes: NORMAL RUN: leave dates/request/run blank. Official calendar and 13:30 Taipei select latest completed session; Saturday resolves Friday. Existing exact request/run resumes; complete work reports without repeating it. diagnose is the explicit READ-ONLY Diagnostics branch; it does not screen, publish or archive. resume never dispatches missing runs. legacy_archive imports only retained immutable dates. revision requires a new request_id. Actions validates official source watermark before supplement.
